findings.spec_location: Known-Unconfirmed calibration table row 'Cross-symphony mean' (line 316); AC-5 S-5.1 and S-5.5; Q-5 and the standing-risk bullet at line 321
findings.spec_says: The cross-symphony mean gap at 0.001 is 'about +2.1' bps a day. S-5.1 writes that figure into the code comment, and S-5.5 requires every number there to equal this table. Q-5 says the mean gap at 0.0027 is 'about +14'. S-5.1 also states '87 trading days since each tree's last edit' for all 8 symphonies.
findings.code_does: The plan's own per-symphony rows do not produce +2.1. At 0.001 the rows (7.8, 9.3, -2.7, 4.2, 7.1, -11.4, 3.2, -10.5) sum to 7.0, so the simple mean is +0.875 bps a day. Weighted by days (seven symphonies at 87 days, one at 46) the mean is +0.49. The other two means check out: the rows at 0 give -6.45 and the rows at 0.005 give +29.9, matching about -6.5 and about +30. Interpolated from the corrected mean, the gap at 0.0027 is about +13, not +14. Reasonabilists has 46 days, not 87 (the plan's own table, line 312). The figure comes verbatim from the source (G-10), but AC-5 would commit it to code and docs as fact, and a test built from S-5.5 would pin a number the table contradicts.
